scope: Actual loaded MV3 Chrome for Testing on Linux, native action popup, real service worker/storage/content script; disposable guest profile, remote DNS blocked. Editor-origin check uses a synthetic page, not the authenticated app. Not signed-in sync, Google Chrome end-user installation, Web Store publication or a physical device.

results.name: Actual Chrome action popup has native constrained dimensions and no horizontal overflow
Closing native popup keeps the real background session; real content-script typing counts four words once
Pause/resume/end use existing worker state and preserve one session/history record
Real content script suppresses counting/counter at the editor origin; isolated app-owned text is not double counted
Actual popup dark/reduced-motion/Spanish state remains usable with no running animations
